title: Unexpected header information source

problem.expected: The obsolete header information is absent.
problem.actual: The information remains visible although the initially suspected header setting is disabled.
reproduction: Confirm the documented header setting is disabled.

hypotheses.statement: The visible content is generated by the initially suspected theme header setting.
The visible content originates from another configuration or rendering path.

tests.question: Does the rendered element carry evidence linking it to the suspected header setting?
tests.procedure: Inspect the rendered element and relevant attributes/classes using browser developer tools without modifying production state.
tests.evidence: Observed element origin was inconsistent with the initial setting path.
tests.interpretation: H1 weakened/rejected; investigation moved to the alternative rendering path.

cause: A different configuration/rendering path supplied the visible content.
correction: Update the responsible configuration rather than the initially assumed header setting.
verification: Reload the page, confirm the obsolete content is absent, and verify neighboring header elements remain correct.
limitations: Demonstration record; implementation-specific identifiers are intentionally omitted.
